_comment: INCOMPLETE — fixed-date national holidays only. Festival holidays (Holi, Id, Diwali/Muhurat, Dussehra, Guru Nanak Jayanti) move every year and are NOT listed here. Populate from the official list before relying on market-hours logic: https://www.nseindia.com/resources/exchange-communication-holidays. Spec §5.6: load the list annually, check it each January. A missing holiday makes the bot label a closed market as open.
